# deps: remove okteto

**Motivation**

> What's Changing: Starting January 15, 2024, Okteto will be discontinuing the free SaaS tier for individual accounts. This means that access to Okteto Cloud will be unavailable after this date.
>  
> Why This Change: Over the last year, we have shifted our focus as a business to serving Platform and DevX Engineering teams, enabling them to design and automate development experiences with the Okteto Platform. As our product and strategy have evolved, individual developer use cases have become less of a fit for Okteto. You can read more in [this blog post] about the decision to move away from the individual free tier.
>  
> Next Steps: If you are interested in using Okteto’s platform, please reach out and we’ll help your team get started with our commercial SaaS platform, or you can check out a [free 30-day trial] of our Self-Hosted offering of Okteto.
